tldr: Final night of the thirteen-night sequence, launched 6:45pm ET. Iran rejected a US ceasefire deal carried to Tehran by Iraq's Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi, refusing a truce that left control of the strait unresolved; oil settled above $100 for the first time since May.
